notes: Customer is a multi-institution research consortium handling patient-adjacent genomic data. Primary ask: private VPC deployment with customer-managed keys and strict audit trails. Wants in-transit encryption to be mutual-TLS (mTLS) between all service components incl. model serving nodes and internal proxies. Wants TLS termination to happen at their NLB only; Redwood control plane must negotiate mTLS to customer endpoints via provisioned certs. For at-rest, customer insists on envelope encryption using their KMS (customer-managed CMKs), key rotation policy enforced by customer with 90-day rotation window. They asked about HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM / external HSM) and whether Redwood supports key wrapping and asymmetric signing for audit log integrity. Secrets management: prefer integration with HashiCorp Vault for service account secrets and periodic rotation; alternatives acceptable are AWS Secrets Manager with cross-account role. Audit logging: must stream immutable logs to their S3/GCS with write-once retention and SHA256 checksums; need log forwarding to Splunk/QRadar with pre-defined schema. Data residency: model artifacts and KV caches must be pinned to us-east-1 and eu-west-1; no replication outside pinned regions. Performance constraints: chat latency target p50 <= 120ms end-to-end for short prompts, throughput ~600 reqs/min initially. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for strict isolation. Quote request: include pricing for BYOK + HSM option.
